description: Adds generated furniture to an empty room photo you name (public https PNG or JPEG up to 4 MB) with a Workers AI image-to-image model. The result is a generated visual for listing or planning, not a record of the room's real furniture. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
